annotation.title_clean: Consultation on the Draft National Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.title_en: Consultation on the Draft National Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT), Qatar
annotation.summary_en: Bilingual (Arabic/English) consultation notice from Qatar's MCIT inviting comments on the Draft National AI Policy, an umbrella policy built on five pillars: digital infrastructure, data, human capabilities, institutional capacity and AI governance. The policy text is a separate file; this document gives only procedures and questions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft National AI Policy is organised around five pillars including AI Governance
Stakeholders respond by email using a prescribed template
Four consultation questions on objectives, pillars, flexibility and further comments
Draft is not final or binding; MCIT need not adopt comments
Responses may be published and are non-confidential unless justified
